notes.title: Spectacle: Development Update
notes.notes:
Half Past Yellow has made the decision to switch our production focus. Like many studios in the games industry, HPY has had a difficult 18 months. Financial uncertainty has led to many hard decisions for the studio.

The most difficult decision came in May this year, when we had to say goodbye to 2 of our team members. The team at HPY are the most valuable asset the studio has, and it feels terrible to lose key parts of it.

We are staying optimistic about the direction we are taking with our new project and we will be showing footage of our new project on Twitter and Instagram over the next few weeks.

We appreciate all the players who enjoyed the Spectacle demo and wanted to see more. The HPY team are excited by the prospect of returning to the project one day, but the internal status is currently: delayed indefinitely.

If you are interested in learning more, I put together a longer piece for this months blog post
